# Installed by hipdnn-superbuild-ci.yml into the venv it passes as
# -DPython3_EXECUTABLE, before "Configure superbuild"; that step explains why the
# ordering matters for pytest.
#
# pytest -- the descriptor-packaging suite, and the frontend wheel tests.
# build  -- the PEP 517 frontend that packs the frontend wheel.
# numpy  -- imported by frontend_wheel_package/tests, not by the build.
# PyYAML -- IngestorGenerator/codegen/config_loader.py imports it, and that module
#           is imported by the suite's conftest, so it is needed to collect the
#           suite at all rather than by any single case.
# Jinja2 -- the generator's template engine, reached from the same conftest import.
#
# PyYAML and Jinja2 are the generator's own declared requirements
# (IngestorGenerator/requirements.txt); they are repeated here because that file is
# not installed by this workflow and the interpreter below is the one its ctest
# entry runs under.
#
# Installed with --upgrade, so nothing is pinned here.
pytest
build
numpy
PyYAML
Jinja2
